findings.description: The list of arguments includes hidden arguments. The old code relied on get_help_record, which for Argument returned None only when help is None. Hidden arguments are not filtered here, so they appear in the help section.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has an Argument with hidden=True (supported in click 8.2+) and at least one documented argument. Mechanism: the new code does not check param.hidden. Impact: hidden arguments show up in the Positional arguments help, leaking them. The confidence is moderate because Argument.get_help_record here has no hidden check, so the old behavior also showed them.
